name: The Castles of Burgundy

categories.label: Points earned in play
categories.help: Everything you scored during the game: tiles, regions, bonus tiles and goods.

categories.label: Unsold goods
categories.help: One point for each goods tile you never sold.

categories.label: Silverlings
categories.help: One point for each silverling left at the end.

categories.label: Worker tile pairs
categories.help: One point for every two worker tiles left at the end.

categories.label: Knowledge tiles
categories.help: Points shown on your yellow knowledge tiles.

categories.label: Empty estate spaces
categories.help: Empty spaces on your estate; fewer wins a tie per the printed rule.

notes: Printed tie-break: fewest empty estate spaces, then whoever went later in turn order (not modelled). A BGG snippet suggests the English printing was later corrected to most empty spaces; this is unconfirmed, so confirm before shipping. Rules read from a third-party host of the publisher PDF.
